## How each date is fixed

The meeting date is the date in the note's heading (`Committee meeting, …`). The year is 2026 in every heading. Filenames are only a cross-check. The "Next meeting" lines form one chain and agree with those headings:

11 August → 25 August (held 26 August) → 8 September → 22 September → 6 October → 20 October → 3 November.

`minutes 25 aug.md` is the one case where the filename and the meeting date differ. The heading is **26 August 2026**, and the first line says the meeting was moved from 25 August because of the storm. The file will be named for **26 August 2026**, the day it was held. The note text stays as written, including "Monday 25 August". On the 2026 calendar, 25 August was a Tuesday and 26 August was a Wednesday. That weekday clash stays in the note.

## Renames

All seven notes move with `mv` only. Targets are new names, so nothing is overwritten. `README.md` and `members.csv` stay as they are.

| Current file | New name |
|---|---|
| `notes/aug11.md` | `notes/2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md` |
| `notes/minutes 25 aug.md` | `notes/2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md` |
| `notes/Meeting sept 8.md` | `notes/2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md` |
| `notes/notes_2026-09-22.md` | `notes/2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md` |
| `notes/oct6 meeting notes.md` | `notes/2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md` |
| `notes/2026.10.20 minutes.md` | `notes/2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md` |
| `notes/Nov 3 (final).md` | `notes/2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md` |

## New `notes/index.md`

One new file, notes in date order, one decision line each:

- [2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md](2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md) — Repaint the noticeboard (Odile Fairweather, by 25 August), move the shed lights to the night rate, and ask the city about a second tap by 8 September.
- [2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md](2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md) — The shed lights are on the night rate, and Nell will ask the city again about the second tap before 8 September.
- [2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md](2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md) — Replace the shed roof before winter, and email autumn fee reminders by 15 September.
- [2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md](2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md) — Accept the $1,480 roof quote, send fee reminders by 29 September, order four cubic metres of compost by 2 October, and hand the second-tap request to Dov Marchetti.
- [2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md](2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md) — Wren will replace the gate latch by 20 October, the garden closes at the end of November, and Tessa will draft the winter closing checklist by 3 November.
- [2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md](2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md) — Hold a work day on Saturday 14 November, 09:30 to 12:30, and do not pay the roof invoice until the extra $80 is explained.
- [2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md](2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md) — Withhold the roof payment until the extra $80 is explained, collect checklist comments by 10 November, and hold no further meetings this year.

## Check that no note text was lost

This folder is not a git repo, so the check is byte identity. Baseline SHA-256 and sizes are already recorded:

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---|
| `aug11.md` | 548 | `c98ee0f877c927b1f5230ea643be263038b904616995c901d63c26fe400759ae` |
| `minutes 25 aug.md` | 421 | `628859141447cf2ad3230260ea4bc27222538fa69b99016bbb4fc99aec1ae431` |
| `Meeting sept 8.md` | 914 | `518d3fc96a22e50544f987195941f86c5d092f704ce73528fa9db5b9e459b40f` |
| `notes_2026-09-22.md` | 795 | `048a4ab6ef7f8b201f2768035de80bcb03d578b0b7f8a69f5240dc5ba0468039` |
| `oct6 meeting notes.md` | 591 | `4b4ad762b822f8a2058bcb3cef41391fe5f917528c4dbb595af9bc2d0b9b021b` |
| `2026.10.20 minutes.md` | 732 | `49127e28f15d3db7ed7731eadcd08c97ce977fa5070d424b06eaeef763b594df` |
| `Nov 3 (final).md` | 814 | `0f3713c5dc63c5b8852fadaf8a21738fc7a52d2452f20048b769a8ce993966dd` |

After the moves, each new path must have the same SHA-256 and the same byte count as its source. `notes/` must then contain only those seven files plus `index.md`. The notes will not be opened in an editor, so line endings stay as they are.
